draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Timber Works' setup
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Glad things are going well, and thanks for the quick reply. Happy to take you up on that walkthrough whenever it's useful.

You've got a project created and a teammate invited, which is a good base — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week work? I can walk through how your team is setting things up and answer anything that comes up. Just send me a couple of times that suit you and I'll make one work.

Best,
Chidi
